'''Mark III ''Katarn''-class commando armor''' was the successor of Mark II [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]]. It was issued around ten months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. It featured more enhancements, and was resistant against [[Blaster/Legends|Blaster]] fire up to light cannon rounds. Black-clad camouflage first became available upon the release of the Mark III armor. Mark III armor was EMP hardened and resistant to Verpine rounds, just like the Mark II version. Its incredible resistance to damage was exemplified during a [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege|noted operation]] where commando [[Fi Skirata]] threw himself onto a explosive, managing to survive only being badly shaken, earning him the admiration of the Coruscanti police.
